title: Final Quantum Numbers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify and state the quantum numbers J(eta^0) = 0, P(eta^0) = -1, I(eta^0) = 0, Q(eta^0) = 0, C(eta^0) = +1, and J^{PC}(eta^0) = 0^{-+}.

title: Experimental Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should describe a suitable experimental setup including a pi- beam, hydrogen target, and detection methods for gamma rays and charged particles.

title: Threshold Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct calculation of the threshold energy E_0 and the threshold momentum P_0 for the reaction.

title: Decay Modes Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should analyze the decay modes of eta^0 and relate them to the inferred quantum numbers.

title: S-wave Production Justification
description: Important Criteria: The student must justify the s-wave production mechanism and its implications for the spin of eta^0.

title: Invariant Mass Measurement
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the importance of measuring invariant mass peaks to confirm eta^0 production.

title: Charge Conservation Argument
description: Optional Criteria: The student should explain how charge conservation leads to the conclusion that Q(eta^0) = 0.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as miscalculating the threshold energy or misidentifying the decay modes.
